steps.title: Welcome to DeFi Maxi: Don't Get Rekt!
steps.body:
Meet **Maxi** - a fictional character we created to guide you through the whole course. Maxi isn't real (no podcast, no wallet, no hot takes), think of Maxi as your personal DeFi coach, hype person, and safety buddy rolled into one.

In Web3, the golden rule is simple: **Don't get rekt. Maxi is here to guide you.**

**How each lesson is built.**

Every lesson follows the same rhythm so your brain always knows what is coming next:

- **Read** a short, plain-English explanation of one idea.
- **See** it live in the interactive practice panel on the right.
- **Prove** it with a quick quiz that earns you Aura points.
- **Explore** a real product so the concept stops being abstract.

**Why this is 100% risk-free.**

The safest way to learn DeFi is by doing it yourself with zero fear. So every lesson runs on **Solana Devnet** - a public test network where the SOL and tokens are free play money. You will connect a real <Term id="wallet">wallet</Term>, sign real <Term id="transaction">transactions</Term>, and even watch a swap execute on-chain, yet you can never lose a single cent of real value.

By the end of Tier 1 you will read a wallet, judge a token's safety, understand gas fees, and spot the scams that drain beginners. Let's go.

steps.text: This badge guarantees you are in a safe sandbox using free devnet money. We never touch mainnet.

steps.title: Aura Points
steps.text: Your Aura score lives in the top bar. Answer quiz questions correctly to gain Aura, and wrong answers cost you Aura. Same for verified on-chain tasks - rewards flow straight into your Aura.

steps.title: The Learn Panel
steps.text: Your interactive guide is here on the left. Follow short, clear steps at your own pace.

steps.title: The Practice Panel
steps.text: Interactive simulators and on-chain tasks live here on the right. Try things and see instant results.

steps.title: Need a Hint?
steps.text: If you ever get stuck, tap the Hint button to reveal progressive clues one by one.

steps.title: Safe to Break Things
steps.body:
In traditional crypto, mistakes cost real money: bad slippage, phishing drainers, or sudden liquidations. 

Here at Rekt School, our motto is: **Do it → See what happened → Break it safely before you lose real cash.** If a trade fails or you get simulated-liquidated, celebrate! You just learned an on-chain lesson that saved you thousands of real dollars.

steps.title: Under the Hood: How Wallets and Web3 Apps Talk
steps.body: When you use a DeFi app, the website never holds your money or your keys. Instead, your wallet (like Phantom or Solflare) holds your private key securely in your browser extension. When you want to take an action, like claiming tokens or swapping, the website builds an unsigned transaction and hands it to your wallet. You inspect the details, click 'Approve', and your wallet signs it cryptographically before sending it directly to Solana validators.

questions.prompt: What kind of money is used in Rekt School lessons?
options: Real US Dollars from your bank account
Free Solana Devnet play tokens with zero real-world cost
questions.explainRight: Exactly right! Everything in the course runs on Solana Devnet where tokens are free play money.
questions.explainWrong: Not quite. Rekt School uses Solana Devnet, so all tokens and gas are 100% free play money.

questions.prompt: Does the Rekt School website ever hold your private key or seed phrase?
options: Yes, it stores them in an encrypted database
No, never. Your private key stays exclusively inside your own wallet extension
Yes, but only when you click 'Swap'
Yes, to pay for your gas fees
questions.explainRight: Spot on! Your private key never leaves your wallet extension. The website only prepares transactions for you to review and sign.
questions.explainWrong: Incorrect. In Web3, non-custodial apps never hold or see your private keys or seed phrase.
